status: Iron Halls recording-ready. Great Furnace follows separately.

flint.name: Flint
flint.role: A captive smith who refuses to waste good work or good people

jack.name: Jack
jack.role: A furnace worker keeping his crew alive with practical repairs

ih.flint.first.text: Those blades are headed for villages like yours. Ours, too. We make them because the guards count our families before they count the weapons. If you came to stop this place, start with the people beside the hammer. Get them clear before you touch a valve.

choices.text: Show me how to get them out.

effects.title: Stop the weapon line
effects.text: Flint says the workers must leave their station before the machines stop. Clear the guards at the station ahead, then open the western shelter. Jack works farther north beside the broken service cart.

choices.text: I was going to break the machines.

voice.speaker: flint
voice.scene: First meeting in the receiving yard
voice.emotion: Low, steady male voice. Exhausted, protective, with a dry edge.
voice.direction: Low, steady male voice. Exhausted, protective, with a dry edge.
voice.context: Iron Halls. The player follows Ellis’s notes to stop the Legion’s weapon supply. Captive workers must be protected. No Sunspire/orb knowledge yet. First meeting in the receiving yard

ih.flint.careful.text: Good instinct. Bad first step. Cut a belt under pressure and the men standing beside it pay for your enthusiasm. Clear their guards. Open the shelter. Then we can break things properly.

effects.title: Stop the weapon line
effects.text: Flint says the workers must leave their station before the machines stop. Clear the guards at the station ahead, then open the western shelter. Jack works farther north beside the broken service cart.

voice.speaker: flint
voice.emotion: Firm, not insulting. The final sentence has a little bite of humor.
voice.direction: Firm, not insulting. The final sentence has a little bite of humor.
voice.context: Iron Halls. The player follows Ellis’s notes to stop the Legion’s weapon supply. Captive workers must be protected. No Sunspire/orb knowledge yet. Flint redirects a reckless plan

ih.flint.plan.text: The shelter door is west of their station. Jack is by the service cart beyond it. He knows how to reach the controls. There’s a floor route past the patrols, or the high walkway past the presses. Pick whichever looks less likely to flatten you.

voice.speaker: flint
voice.scene: Directions after agreeing to protect workers
voice.emotion: Practical and specific. A tiny smile at the last line.
voice.direction: Practical and specific. A tiny smile at the last line.
voice.context: Iron Halls. The player follows Ellis’s notes to stop the Legion’s weapon supply. Captive workers must be protected. No Sunspire/orb knowledge yet. Directions after agreeing to protect workers

ih.flint.work.text: One blade blank. Mine. The officers took it to the raised store east of the presses. I made it for a guard who stayed behind to help people flee. Never got to finish it. Bring it back and I’ll put it to work for someone still standing.

choices.text: What would you give me for it?

voice.speaker: flint
voice.emotion: Personal pride, a brief quiet sadness. No melodrama.
voice.direction: Personal pride, a brief quiet sadness. No melodrama.
voice.context: Iron Halls. The player follows Ellis’s notes to stop the Legion’s weapon supply. Captive workers must be protected. No Sunspire/orb knowledge yet. Optional blade recovery

ih.flint.price.text: A weapon worth carrying. Or armor, if you’re fond of the one you have. I’m not paying you to be kind. I’m asking you to save something they meant to turn against us.

voice.speaker: flint
voice.emotion: Blunt, calm. Respect a practical player rather than shame them.
voice.direction: Blunt, calm. Respect a practical player rather than shame them.
voice.context: Iron Halls. The player follows Ellis’s notes to stop the Legion’s weapon supply. Captive workers must be protected. No Sunspire/orb knowledge yet. An openly practical bargain

ih.flint.wait.text: You know where to find me. If anyone asks, I’m working very hard on this exact same dent.

choices.text: Tell me about your own work.
Remind me how to stop the line.

voice.speaker: flint
voice.emotion: Understated joke. He is pretending to obey his orders.
voice.direction: Understated joke. He is pretending to obey his orders.
voice.context: Iron Halls. The player follows Ellis’s notes to stop the Legion’s weapon supply. Captive workers must be protected. No Sunspire/orb knowledge yet. Flint waits at his bench

ih.flint.remind.text: Shelter first. Jack next. He needs handles from the western stores for his cart. At the controls, follow the machine plate. Stop the feed, let the pressure out, then stop the hammer. The safety vent will catch a mistake, but don’t make a hobby of it.

voice.speaker: flint
voice.emotion: Patient, with a dry final warning.
voice.direction: Patient, with a dry final warning.
voice.context: Iron Halls. The player follows Ellis’s notes to stop the Legion’s weapon supply. Captive workers must be protected. No Sunspire/orb knowledge yet. Useful reminder

ih.flint.return.text: Still straight. Better luck than most of us. I found a purple piece caught in the scrap they brought with it. Take that too. As for the metal—tell me what you need.

voice.speaker: flint
voice.emotion: A craftsman happy to do his own work again. The shard is a found object, not new lore.
voice.direction: A craftsman happy to do his own work again. The shard is a found object, not new lore.
voice.context: Iron Halls. The player follows Ellis’s notes to stop the Legion’s weapon supply. Captive workers must be protected. No Sunspire/orb knowledge yet. Choose the fixed rare reward

ih.flint.reward.text: Forgeguard. A decent name, even if the forge doesn’t deserve guarding anymore. Finish your way through these halls before you count it safe. And if you find a quiet town that needs a smith, remember me.

voice.speaker: flint
voice.emotion: Warm, restrained hope. Do not promise an implemented hub shop upgrade.
voice.direction: Warm, restrained hope. Do not promise an implemented hub shop upgrade.
voice.context: Iron Halls. The player follows Ellis’s notes to stop the Legion’s weapon supply. Captive workers must be protected. No Sunspire/orb knowledge yet. Reward handover

ih.flint.stopped.text: Hear that? Me neither. I’d forgotten how good that could sound. The big furnace still feeds the rest of the works. Martin is in there with another crew. Find him before the officers decide who to blame.

voice.speaker: flint
voice.emotion: Relief turns into concern for the next crew.
voice.direction: Relief turns into concern for the next crew.
voice.context: Iron Halls. The player follows Ellis’s notes to stop the Legion’s weapon supply. Captive workers must be protected. No Sunspire/orb knowledge yet. After the line falls silent

ih.jack.first.text: Don’t step on the cart. Unless you’ve always wanted to arrive downstairs in pieces. The brake handles cracked from the heat. There are insulated spares in the western stores. Bring them here and I can lock the whole cart across that gap.

effects.title: A cart that stays put
effects.text: Recover insulated handles from the western stores, then return to Jack beside the cart. He can lock its deck across the gap to the Great Furnace.

choices.text: So it’s more of a falling machine?

voice.speaker: jack
voice.emotion: Fast practical male voice, good humor under pressure.
voice.direction: Fast practical male voice, good humor under pressure.
voice.context: Iron Halls. The player follows Ellis’s notes to stop the Legion’s weapon supply. Captive workers must be protected. No Sunspire/orb knowledge yet. Meeting beside the broken cart

ih.jack.joke.text: Exactly. Very reliable at that part. I’m trying to expand its range.

choices.text: Let’s make it a bridge. Where are the handles?

effects.title: A cart that stays put
effects.text: Get insulated handles from the western stores and return them to Jack.

voice.speaker: jack
voice.scene: A brief joke about the cart
voice.emotion: Deadpan, then a little shared amusement.
voice.direction: Deadpan, then a little shared amusement.
voice.context: Iron Halls. The player follows Ellis’s notes to stop the Legion’s weapon supply. Captive workers must be protected. No Sunspire/orb knowledge yet. A brief joke about the cart

ih.jack.wait.text: Western stores. Thick wrapped grips, not bare metal. There’s a reason most of us only make that mistake once.

choices.text: What is on the high walkway?
How do I shut the line down?

voice.speaker: jack
voice.context: Iron Halls. The player follows Ellis’s notes to stop the Legion’s weapon supply. Captive workers must be protected. No Sunspire/orb knowledge yet. Waiting for the handles

ih.jack.route.text: Two stamping presses. The floor lights up before they drop. Wait beside them, then cross after the strike. Or stay low and deal with the patrols. Nobody gets a prize for being the tallest fool in the building.

voice.speaker: jack
voice.emotion: Clear hazard explanation. Light joke without dismissing the danger.
voice.direction: Clear hazard explanation. Light joke without dismissing the danger.
voice.context: Iron Halls. The player follows Ellis’s notes to stop the Legion’s weapon supply. Captive workers must be protected. No Sunspire/orb knowledge yet. Explaining the two approaches

ih.jack.controls.text: The plate by the controls shows the order. Feed first, pressure next, hammer last. Get the workers into shelter before you start. If you get it wrong, the safety vent resets the line. Loud, but better than a funeral.

voice.speaker: jack
voice.emotion: Confident technical knowledge in simple language.
voice.direction: Confident technical knowledge in simple language.
voice.context: Iron Halls. The player follows Ellis’s notes to stop the Legion’s weapon supply. Captive workers must be protected. No Sunspire/orb knowledge yet. Shutdown instructions

ih.jack.fixed.text: That’s it. Brakes set, deck locked. It’s a bridge now, which is a promotion. Shut the weapon line down before you cross. Once it stops, those molds in the western casting room should be cool enough to open.

voice.speaker: jack
voice.emotion: Audible relief and a little pride.
voice.direction: Audible relief and a little pride.
voice.context: Iron Halls. The player follows Ellis’s notes to stop the Legion’s weapon supply. Captive workers must be protected. No Sunspire/orb knowledge yet. The cart becomes a crossing

ih.jack.after.text: I’ll keep this way clear. You handle the big furnace. Between us, perhaps tomorrow we can make something that isn’t a sword.

voice.speaker: jack
voice.emotion: Hopeful, tired. Leave space around the last sentence.
voice.direction: Hopeful, tired. Leave space around the last sentence.
